measures.title: Charter Amendment: County Auditor's Power to Employ
measures.summary: Would let the County Auditor hire a deputy and exercise the same powers over employees in the Auditor's office as executive-branch department heads have. The Deputy County Auditor could act when the County Auditor is not available and perform other duties the Auditor assigns.
measures.yesMeans: The County Auditor may hire a deputy and manage office staff with the same powers as executive department heads.
measures.noMeans: The Auditor's office continues without a deputy position and without these employment powers.
